resources.string: Waiting for this contact\'s inbox — you\'ll be able to send in a moment.

Messages to this contact are still encrypted, but they don\'t yet get the extra protection that keeps past messages safe if a key is later exposed. This usually clears once they reply. If it persists, remove and re-add the contact.
Secure channel could not be established with this contact. Messages are not being sent. Remove the contact and pair again.

Reports are reviewed and acted on within 24 hours. Your report is sent from your own email app, so it will show us your email address — and the draft is stored by that app, outside Rún, where it won\'t be erased if you wipe Rún.
